source.filter: Common State Abbreviation == OH; HPSA Status != Withdrawn

interpretation: The retained file can support a bounded coordinate-based follow-up for facility-type rows, but not resident travel time or reachable care for population/geographic HPSA rows. HPSA designation is not appointment availability, insurance acceptance, wait, completed use, or recovery.
next_test: For the 94 coordinate-bearing rows, validate active facility identity, service type, hours, accepting patients/insurance, and travel-time assumptions; keep the 1248 non-coordinate rows as an explicit missingness boundary and do not assign their county label to every resident. The official HRSA Health Center Service Delivery and Look-Alike Sites CSV is the next controlled site-identity route: it lists more than 16,200 sites, is refreshed daily, and was listed at approximately 10.5 MB on the 2026-08-26 catalog entry; acquire only the Ohio-filtered slice or use a documented query/export.
storage_boundary: Uses the already retained public aggregate/component file; no patient or appointment records are retained.
